description: İtfaiye Dairesi Başkanlığı: emergency and critical facilities datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by İtfaiye Dairesi Başkanlığı. Coverage: İtfaiye Dairesi Başkanlığı. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about emergency and critical facilities; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: İtfaiye Eğitimleri ve İlkyardım Çalışmaları; İtfaiye Araç Sayısı; İtfaiye Personel Sayısı. Formats seen: XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
